text: A matrix is a rectangular arrangement of numbers. This matrix has two rows and three columns. We write its dimensions as two by three. To locate an entry, choose the row first, then the column.

Solve two x plus three equals eleven. Subtract three from both sides. That leaves two x equals eight. Now divide both sides by two. We get x equals four. Substitute four into the original equation to check the answer.
